title: Touchdown
tagline: Land on a pad before the fuel runs out, at the gravity of the world you're really at.
description: A side-on lander. Turn, burn and bring the gear down on a lit pad, level and slow; the narrow pads score most and a soft touchdown doubles it. Every landing tops the tanks up a little. If your journal says you're near a world, the game lands at its gravity: a 2.4 g world lands at 2.4 g, with the high-gravity warning in red. Away from any body it makes a world up.
